name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This ensures 7:1 contrast on dark backgrounds and meets WCAG 2.2 AA for keyboard users. The trade-off is slightly larger focus rings, but it guarantees visibility for users with low vision or color blindness.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px #000 outer ring with a 1px white inner ring. This guarantees 7:1 contrast on both light and dark patterned backgrounds, meeting WCAG 2.2 AAA for focus visibility. The trade-off is slightly smaller focus rings, but it eliminates the risk of blending into any background while keeping the indicator crisp for all users.

name: Reader
text: The 3px #000 ring risks disappearing on dark patterned backgrounds where it blurs.
